picks.title: Adam launches Migrations for AI CAD data translation
picks.rationale: New AI release that rebuilds a CAD model's parametric feature history in a different CAD system. It goes after vendor lock-in directly, which matters to any product designer switching tools.
picks.excerpt: Adam looks to 'end vendor lock-in' with Migrations, which uses AI to rebuild a CAD model's parametric history in a new CAD system.

picks.title: State of agent skills
picks.rationale: First-party data report on the skills.sh registry (1M skills, about 280M installs) showing what people teach agents and what sticks. It gives design-to-code teams evidence on which agent skills are worth building or installing.
picks.excerpt: In seven months, the skills.sh registry grew to 1 million agent skills with nearly 280 million installs. This report uses aggregate data from that registry to examine what people teach agents, what gets installed, and what lasts.

picks.title: Flux adds AI tools for 3D-printable PCB enclosures
picks.rationale: Prompt-to-enclosure: describe the requirements, and the case updates when the board changes and exports for 3D-printed prototypes. A concrete text-to-CAD feature that hardware and industrial designers can use now.
picks.excerpt: Users can describe enclosure requirements, update designs with board changes and export models for physical prototype testing.

picks.title: Claude Opus 5.5 - 5 Real Uses and One BIG Website Showdown!
picks.rationale: Hands-on look at a brand-new frontier model, including a website-building showdown. It shows designers what the new model does for real web and UI output.
picks.excerpt: Want to save time, get more leverage, and stop figuring this AI stuff out from scratch? I put the clearest map and support inside the AI Advantage Club: http...

picks.title: Microsoft thinks its new Copilot ‘super app’ will be as influential as Office
picks.rationale: Product release, not business news: Copilot now combines chat, coding, and Autopilot agents in one app. It changes the everyday AI workspace many design teams in Microsoft shops will be working in.
picks.excerpt: The new Copilot merges AI chat, coding, and Autopilot agents.
